title: Remote Land Due Diligence in Bangladesh: How Expats in USA, UK & Canada Can Verify Khatians & Namjari Online (2026)
metaTitle: Verify Land in Bangladesh from Abroad: NRB Title Search Guide 2026
metaDescription: Step-by-step guide for NRBs in USA, UK & Canada to verify CS, SA, RS, BS Khatians, e-Namjari, and fake Dalils in Bangladesh online before buying or investing.
keywords: check bangladesh land record online from abroad
legal vetting of property in bangladesh
heroIntro: Hard-earned foreign remittances sent by Non-Resident Bangladeshis (NRBs) in the United States, United Kingdom, Canada, and the Middle East are frequently targeted by deceptive real estate syndicates, fake developer housing societies, and fraudulent sellers in Bangladesh. Buying real estate, plots, or apartments without comprehensive **Legal Due Diligence and Title Search (স্বত্ব অনুসন্ধান ও দলিলের বৈধতা যাচাই)** is a recipe for catastrophic financial loss. Thanks to Bangladesh's digitized land management reforms (land.gov.bd, e-Porcha, and DLRS map portals), overseas buyers can now conduct rigorous preliminary checks from anywhere in the world before engaging a qualified advocate for an on-site Non-Encumbrance Title Search Report.

quickAnswer.heading: The 5-Point Remote Title Due Diligence Rule
points: Verify the 25-Year Chain of Title (পিট দলিল / বায়া দলিল) spanning unbroken ownership back to the original CS or SA Khatian.
Cross-check digital Khatians (RS, City Survey, or BS) directly on the Ministry of Land portal (eporcha.gov.bd / land.gov.bd).
Verify that the seller's e-Namjari (ই-নামজারি) mutation is genuine and matches the DCR (Duplicate Carbon Receipt) and online tax Dakhila.
Conduct a physical Volume Book search at the relevant Sub-Registry Office to ensure the deed is not forged or revoked.
Obtain a Non-Encumbrance Certificate (NEC) from the Sub-Registrar to verify the property is not secretly mortgaged to a commercial bank.

sections.h2: Why Remote Land Due Diligence is Critical for NRBs
sections.content: In Bangladesh, physical possession does NOT automatically guarantee legal title. Fraudulent sellers routinely create forged Porchas, sell mortgaged land, or execute multiple deeds for the same plot to different expatriate buyers. Conducting independent due diligence remotely prevents capital trap in intractable litigation.

sections.h2: The 25-Year Chain of Title (বায়া দলিল / Baya Dalil) Tracing
sections.content:
Under the standards established by the Supreme Court of Bangladesh, an unassailable title search requires tracing ownership back at least 25 years through the chain of previous deeds (বায়া দলিল / Baya Dalil):

  1. Original Settlement Survey: Match the plot's origin against the CS (Cadastral Survey 1888–1940) or SA (State Acquisition Survey 1956) records.
  2. Subsequent Revisional Surveys: Verify transition through the RS (Revisional Survey) and modern City Survey / BS (Bangladesh Survey).
  3. Transfer Deeds: Every historical sale deed, gift deed (Heba), partition deed, or succession inheritance must link seamlessly without any unexplained gap in ownership or acreage.

sections.h2: How to Verify Khatians (CS, SA, RS, BS) on eporcha.gov.bd
sections.content:
The Ministry of Land's official portal eporcha.gov.bd allows expats to inspect land records online from London, New York, or Toronto:

  • Select Division (বিভাগ), District (জেলা), Upazila/Thana, and Mouza (মৌজা).
  • Select Khatian Type (CS, SA, RS, or BS).
  • Enter Khatian number or Dag (Plot) number or owner's name.
  • Verify whether the seller's named predecessor is recorded as a genuine tenant (রায়ত) and cross-check the recorded land area (একর / শতাংশ).
  • Apply online for an officially signed certified copy (সার্টিফাইড কপি) delivered via international courier or collected locally by your advocate.

Possessing an old deed is useless if the seller has not mutated their name in government records:

Visit mutation.land.gov.bd. Enter the Division, District, Thana, Application Number, and NID. A genuine mutation generates an official Mutation Khatian (নামজারি খতিয়ান), a Duplicate Carbon Receipt (DCR) showing BDT 1,150 government fee payment, and an official signature from the Assistant Commissioner (Land).

If the seller produces a paper mutation slip that does not exist in the Land Reforms Board online database, it is 100% forged.

Land Development Tax (ভূমি উন্নয়ন কর) must be up to date:

  • Access ldtax.gov.bd.
  • Input the owner's Holding Number and Mouza.
  • Verify if all land holding taxes are cleared up to the current fiscal year.
  • A clean digital Dakhila (দাখিলা) confirms that the local land revenue office recognizes the seller as the active, paying occupant.

sections.h2: The Vital Sub-Registry Search: Volume Book Inspection & NEC
sections.content:
Online checks are only the first half of due diligence. An advocate must perform physical searches at the Sub-Registry Office:

  1. Volume Book Inspection (বালাম বই তল্লাশি): The advocate inspects the physical Register Book to verify that the deed number, date, stamp serial, and thumbprints match the office record exactly.
  2. Non-Encumbrance Certificate (NEC - দায়মুক্ত সনদ): Under Form 41 of the Registration Rules, apply for an NEC spanning 12 to 25 years. This search confirms that the land has not been mortgaged to a bank, attached by a civil court decree, or sold to a third party.

sections.h2: Identifying Red Flags: Vested, Waqf, Forest, and Khas Land
sections.content:
Never purchase without confirming the land does not fall under restricted government categories:

  • Khas Land (সরকারি খাস জমি): Land owned exclusively by the government under Section 86 of the SAT Act.
  • Vested Property 'Ka' Schedule: Encumbered under Vested Property legislation.
  • Waqf / Debottar Property: Dedicated religious endowments that cannot be alienated without sanction from the Waqf Administrator or District Judge.
  • Acquisition Gazette (এল.এ. কেইস): Check whether the Deputy Commissioner's Land Acquisition (LA) branch has gazetted the plot for mega-projects, highways, or metro rail.

sections.h2: Commissioning a Formal Advocate Legal Opinion Report
sections.content: Before transferring any earnest money or down-payment from abroad, insist on a formal written Legal Search & Title Opinion Report (স্বত্ব মতামত প্রতিবেদন) signed by an enrolled advocate of the Supreme Court of Bangladesh. The report certifies whether the title is marketable, free from encumbrance, and safe for foreign remittance investment.

faqs.question: Can I check my ancestral property Khatian online from the USA or UK?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can access eporcha.gov.bd or land.gov.bd 24/7 to search CS, SA, RS, and BS Khatians by district, mouza, and plot number.

faqs.question: What is the difference between Khatian and Dalil in Bangladesh?
faqs.answer: A Dalil (Deed) is the legal transfer contract executed between parties at the Sub-Registry. A Khatian (Record of Rights / Porcha) is the official government land revenue survey record reflecting title and tax liability.

faqs.question: How do I know if a property is mortgaged to a bank in Bangladesh?
faqs.answer: An advocate must conduct a Non-Encumbrance Certificate (NEC) search at the Sub-Registry Office and cross-verify with the Credit Information Bureau (CIB) records.

faqs.question: Can a housing developer sell a plot without RAJUK approval in Dhaka?
faqs.answer: No. Under the Private Residential Land Development Rules 2004, selling unapproved plots or advertising unapproved housing projects is strictly illegal and subject to criminal prosecution.

faqs.question: How much does a professional Title Search and Legal Opinion report cost?
faqs.answer: Depending on the complexity of the chain of title, number of previous deeds, and registry searches, advocate fees typically range from BDT 25,000 to BDT 60,000 ($250–$600 USD).
